experiment_name: Full-Scale Inverted Index & Query Pipeline Optimization

root_causes_diagnosed.char3_index: At 4.887M scale, document frequencies for common character 3-grams exceed 5,000, triggering fallback retrieval of top-4 rarest 3-grams whose combined posting lists contain 50,000+ candidate IDs. In Python, evaluating 50k candidate ID additions in dictionary hashes per query caused 100M+ interpreter dict operations and 2,000 full TimSorts on 50k-element arrays.
root_causes_diagnosed.candidate_preprocessing: PreprocessedCandidate constructor was repeatedly calling normalize_text (regex substitutions) on already-normalized candidate strings and discarding representations at batch boundaries, causing ~250,000 object allocations and 800,000 regex evaluations per batch.

optimizations_applied: Single-posting list fast path (O(1) direct slice without dict creation or sort)
C-speed dict.fromkeys initialization for multi-list scoring
Zero-regex fast PreprocessedCandidate constructor on pre-normalized strings
Global persistent candidate cache across S1 streaming lifecycle
